2014_spells.infestation.description: You cause a cloud of mites, fleas, and other parasites to appear momentarily on one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it takes 1d6 poison damage and moves 5 feet in a random direction if it can move and its speed is at least 5 feet.
2014_spells.infestation.effectSummary: Deal 1d6 poison damage to a target within 30 ft
2014_spells.infestation.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you cause a cloud of mites, fleas, and other parasites to appear momentarily on one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw; roll a d20, add the CON modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC, or it takes 1d6 poison damage and moves 5 feet in a random direction if it can move and its speed is at least 5 feet; The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6). The effect happens immediately and then ends.
